#nullable enable
using LoadReferenceData.Csv;
using LoadReferenceData.TestDoubles;
using Xunit;

namespace LoadReferenceData.Tests;

public class DesignationCsvRowSourceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ReadAsync_ReadsEveryRow_FromTheSampleFile()
    {
        using var harness = new PackageHarness();
        var package = harness.Package();
        var source = package.FF_SRC_Designation();

        var rows = new List<DesignationCsvRow>();
        await foreach (var row in source.ReadAsync(CancellationToken.None)) rows.Add(row);

        Assert.Equal(2, rows.Count);
        var first = rows[0];
        Assert.Equal(7, first.DesignationID);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.DesignationCode);
        Assert.Equal("Sample", first.Title);
        Assert.Equal(7, first.JobLevel);
        Assert.Equal("Sampl", first.Band);
    }
}
